context: 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS KRINTAFEL tablets are pink, film‑coated, capsule-shaped tablets debossed with ‘GS J11’ on one side and contain 150 mg of tafenoquine.

TRATION 2.2 Recommended Dosage and Administration The recommended dose of KRINTAFEL in patients aged 16 years and older is a single dose of 300 mg administered as two 150-mg tablets taken together. Coadminister KRINTAFEL on the first or second day of chloroquine therapy for acute P. vi
